description: This file contains the utility class ModelActionUtil, which provides a static method to manipulate the context and result maps within the OFBiz widget modeling framework, specifically handling query strings and related data.

classes.name: ModelActionUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to assist with widget model actions in OFBiz, particularly concerning context and result map handling.

methods.name: contextPutQueryStringOrAllResult
methods.description: Populates the context map with data from the results map. If a result map accessor is provided and non-empty, it updates the result map, extracts a query string, encodes it, and updates the context accordingly; otherwise, it copies all entries from the result map into the context.
